title: Document the factory contract validation entry point
objective: Give agents and operators one documented, tested way to validate factory agent, skill, and execution-contract definitions before relying on them.

requirements.description: Document the read-only factory validation command, its scope, and its exit-code meaning.
Keep documented validation commands consistent with scripts/validate.sh and the CI jobs that run them.
Preserve existing application test and build coverage; document only, without changing runtime behavior.

adrReferences.note: Referenced to confirm the prohibited boundary: this documentation task must not alter the accepted authentication implementation.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The documented factory validation command matches the implemented validate.sh mode and exits nonzero for invalid definitions.
Every relative documentation link added by the task resolves to an existing repository path.
Existing backend, frontend, database, migration, and end-to-end validation categories remain unchanged.

boundaries.notes: Documentation-only task. New contract examples are referenced, not edited. No application, authentication, migration, or deployment file may change.
